## 8bc2bc6a9bb8

**Reproduced under-identification: footprint-first sorting survives the entire
generated distribution sampled.** The intended rule sorts color-8 components by
occupied-cell count. A plausible rival instead sorts first by bounding-box area,
uses occupied-cell count only to break equal-footprint ties, then performs the
same palette recoloring, bottom alignment, spacing, and packing. This rival fits
both public training pairs and all **8,000/8,000** generated draws checked
(seeds 0–99, sample indices 0–19, default/easy/medium/hard). Consequently it fits
all **8,000/8,000** cyclic four-demo lessons in that sample. The sample contained
6,000 distinct complete inputs and all four schedule profiles. Evidence:
`checks/audit/8bc2bc6a9bb8/probe.json` and `receipt.json`.

The cause is structural: every shape in the finite `SHAPE_BANK` makes bounding-box
area monotone with cell count; where two sizes can share a footprint, the rival's
cell-count tie-break restores the intended order. Thus the declared competitors
never test which quantity is primary.

A validator-accepted 8x12 counterexample uses a five-cell line (footprint 5), a
four-cell L (footprint 6), and a singleton. The intended rule puts the five-cell
line first; the rival puts the L first. `self_check` returns no errors. It is in
the documented ordinary validator domain but not the narrower strict canonical
profile because its areas are `(5,4,1)` rather than `(4,3,1)`. Canonical Racket
returns the intended 3x10 output and disagrees with the retained rival output:
`checks/audit/8bc2bc6a9bb8/input.json`, `racket.json`, and
`rival_output.json`. The Racket receipt binds generator SHA-256
`a4628bb6520d8d4805b5a99b699598c00ce1816fc6f4f20fffbeb8b3fb6f01a3`
and rule hash `45fdce305a90`.

The target's supported portable task-test stage still passes **12/12** tests
(`checks/audit/8bc2bc6a9bb8/task-tests-run/`). A future task-scoped repair should
add a scheduled footprint/order conflict like this counterexample, declare the
rival, and require every lesson window to refute it. No audit-target source was
modified.

## 8bc2bc6a9bb8

**Reproduced generator-distribution shortcut, independently confirming a retained
same-source unresolved finding.** Exact source SHA-256
`a4628bb6520d8d4805b5a99b699598c00ce1816fc6f4f20fffbeb8b3fb6f01a3`;
executed canonical rule hash `45fdce305a90`. The intended operation sorts shapes
by occupied-cell count. A rival sorts by bounding-box footprint descending,
breaks equal-footprint ties by occupied-cell count, and otherwise performs the
same recoloring, bottom alignment, spacing, and packing.

In a fresh bounded run, the rival matches all 3/3 canonical pairs and 32/32
generated pairs (seed 17, indices 0..7, default/easy/medium/hard). All 35 outputs
were checked with actual canonical Racket execution. The rival survives 32/32
cyclic four-demo windows and also agrees on their generated queries, so ordinary
in-distribution lessons never expose the competing primary sort key.

| Occupied-cell area | Available bounding-box areas |
|---:|---|
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 3, 4 |
| 4 | 4, 6 |
| 5 | 6, 9 |

The finite shape bank has no footprint-order reversals; rotations preserve these
areas. The rival's tie-break recovers intended ordering at equal footprints.
The counterexample uses a five-cell line (footprint 5), a four-cell L (footprint
6), and a singleton. Its input is 8×12 and self_check returns no errors. Actual
Racket packs the five-cell line first into a 3×10 output; the rival puts the L
first and returns a different 3×10 output. This is an ordinary-validator-domain
witness, outside the strict canonical inventory (5,4,1 instead of 4,3,1). That
strict-profile distinction is not treated as an authority error.

Evidence: `checks/audit/8bc2bc6a9bb8/reproduce.py`, `evidence.json`, `run.log`, and
`wrapper-import-failure.log`. Evidence retains all arrays, generator/reproducer/
bridge/wrapper/parser/prelude hashes, exact wrapped Racket program and outputs,
profile calls, rival predictions, and the constructive shape-bank inspection.
The rival reuses the audited component parser and independently sorts/packs;
Racket remains the label authority. Successful wrapper run exit 0. An initial
namespace import failure is retained; the successful probe maps the complete
unchanged shared/tools directory as the expected scripts package without shared
edits or runtime stubs. This fresh 32-draw run does not claim to repeat the
inherited 8,000-draw report. No fix or approval upgrade is included. A future
repair should schedule an occupied-area/footprint-order conflict and verify that
every intended lesson retains a witness against this rival.
